FRONT.label: front view
FRONT.instruction: Render the character from a direct front view, facing the viewer squarely.

body_instructions.body-reference: Render the body from a direct front view, facing the viewer squarely.
body_instructions.head-fitment: Use the Reference Body as a direct front-view neck-fitment source. The body faces the viewer squarely.
body_instructions.character-assembly: Preserve the Reference Body as a direct front-view full-body source, facing the viewer squarely.

head_instructions.head-fitment: Render the Character Head and fitted neck from a direct front view, facing the viewer squarely.
head_instructions.character-assembly: Preserve the Character Head as a direct front-view head source, facing the viewer squarely.

FRONT_LEFT_3_4.label: front-left three-quarter view
FRONT_LEFT_3_4.instruction: Render the character from a front-left three-quarter body view. The torso, neck, and mannequin head all face the same front-left three-quarter direction. The head is not independently turned toward the viewer and is not looking away from the body direction.

body_instructions.body-reference: Render the body from a front-left three-quarter body view. The torso, neck, and mannequin head all face the same front-left three-quarter direction. The head is not independently turned toward the viewer and is not looking away from the body direction.
body_instructions.head-fitment: Use the Reference Body as a front-left three-quarter neck-fitment source. The torso and neck establish the same front-left three-quarter direction for docking.
body_instructions.character-assembly: Preserve the Reference Body as a front-left three-quarter full-body source. Do not rotate, mirror, or reinterpret the body direction.

head_instructions.head-fitment: Render the Character Head and fitted neck from a front-left three-quarter view. Do not turn it toward the viewer or away from the requested head direction.
head_instructions.character-assembly: Preserve the Character Head as a front-left three-quarter source. Do not rotate, mirror, or reinterpret the head direction.
